name: Residence Card for a Foreign Company Manager/Director (Gérant/DG)

qualifying_event.description: For a foreign national who is the manager (gérant) or managing director of a Moroccan company, on the basis of that role rather than an employment contract.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Company statutes and registration (J form); proof the company's registered capital is fully paid up ('libéré'); bank statements showing active business operations; lease/residence proof; criminal record extracts (Moroccan and home country); Moroccan medical certificate.

requirements.blocker_text: The company's registered capital must be fully paid up ('libéré'); no specific minimum dirham figure was confirmed in this pass.
Bank statements and financial records must show the company maintains active operational status.

evidence_required.document: Company statutes and J form (registration certificate)
Criminal record extracts (Morocco and home country)

outcome.duration_length: not confirmed to tier-1 precision in this pass; general carte d'immatriculation progression (1yr, then 2-3yr, 5yr, 10yr) is assumed to apply

sources.title: Westfield Morocco (relocation/company-formation consultancy blog) -- residence permit process for a foreign gérant/DG of a Moroccan company: document list, fully-paid-capital requirement, no permit duration stated
